entries.text: party XP establishes a per-character numeric baseline; party size scales durability and a limited amount of tempo, not raw per-hit damage. entries.text: Per-creature durability is divided by enemy count. Base damage dice are divided by the square root of enemy count. Status severity and AP gain decrease as the count rises.
